encoding: UTF-8, no byte order mark, LF line endings, one JSON object per line, keys in the order id, feature, input, tokens, subtokens; U+0085, U+2028 and U+2029 are escaped although JSON does not require it, so that splitting on LF is the only reading
ordering: the synthetic cases first, in the order §16.5 lists the features they cover, then the real samples in store iteration order
sampling: a record contributes its expression when the first four bytes of blake2b(key, 8), read big-endian, are below 32124418, and its name when the last four are below 6392304; each record decides on its own, so the sample is reproducible from the store alone
